description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeOnLeaveDaoTest' that tests the functionality of the 'EmployeeOnLeaveDao' data access object within the OrangeHRM system, specifically focusing on retrieving and counting employee leave data based on different filters. It includes test methods for verifying list retrieval and count operations with various date and employee access filters.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class to verify the correct operation of EmployeeOnLeaveDao methods, including retrieving and counting employee leave records with various filters.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeOnLeaveDao instance, sets up test fixtures using configuration paths, and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeOnLeaveList
methods.description: Tests the getEmployeeOnLeaveList method of EmployeeOnLeaveDao under different filter scenarios, verifying returned data correctness for various dates and access filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeOnLeaveCount
methods.description: Tests the getEmployeeOnLeaveCount method of EmployeeOnLeaveDao, verifying accurate leave count calculations based on different filters.
